items.headline:
MORTGAGE RATES HIT ONE-YEAR HIGH

US mortgage rates climbed to 6.55%, their highest level in nearly a year, as renewed Middle East tensions fueled inflation fears.

Higher borrowing costs are cooling demand, with home sales falling and many first-time buyers priced out.
